statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptoms with underlying arrhythmic activity
